description: The PWR Series complete bikes are Stay Strong's first range of race ready bikes. Ready to Race straight out of the box, the PWR Series has everything a rider needs to become a fully fledged BMX racer. Stay Strong understand riders/racers needs and every part, detail and logo placement has been thoroughly thought out. With a race winning geometry, disc specific frame, Stay Strong branded bars, cranks, rims, seat and forks and an integrated headset, quick release seat clamp, cable actuated disc brakes, ODI x Stay Strong Reactiv grips and Tioga Powerblock tyres... They have you covered. ###section### Product Specs FRAME MATERIAL: 6061 Alloy WHEEL SIZE: 20" TOP TUBE LENGTH: 18.5" CHAIN STAY LENGTH: 12.7" HEAD TUBE ANGLE: 72.5° SEAT TUBE ANGLE: 70° FORKS: Full 4130 Chromoly BARS: Alloy 4.5" STEM: Forged Alloy Front Load, 40mm HEADSET: Sealed Intergrated BRAKE MOUNTS: Frame Mounted Disc Brake BRAKES: Mechanical Disc brake with Alloy Lever FRONT HUB: 28h Alloy Hub wih fully sealed bearing FRONT RIM: 28h Alloy Double Wall REAR HUB: 28h Alloy Cassette Hub with Disc - 16T Cog REAR RIM: 28h Alloy Double Wall TYRES: Front: Tioga Powerblock 20 x 1-1/8", Rear: Tioga Powerblock 20 x 1-1/8" SPROCKET: Steel 40t CRANKS: Alloy 3pc 155mm BB: JIS PEDALS: Mini Slim Nylon SEAT: Stay Strong Slim Combo Seat/Post GEARING: 40/16 WEIGHT: 20.5lbs / 9.3Kgs ###section### Product Highlights Junior sized BMX bike. Designed for the needs of racers who are 4ft 6" - 5ft 1" (138cm - 155cm) A BMX race specific bike great for those riders just getting started Lightweight 1-1/8" wide wheels for low rolling resitance Responsive mechanical disc brake. Lightweight 6061 alloy frame ###shogun-image-section###
